U.note: Convincing blue-liquid dome with a gold collar, wooden plinth and snowy cabin, but the big slider panel crowds the staging and the snow is faint.

V.note: Charming lamplit shelf room with a red music-box base, but the globe is tiny and its scene is hard to read.

W.note: Polished night cabin with moon, smoke, pines and a snowy mound inside a clean glass dome on a wooden base, tidy controls, good phone layout.

X.note: Beautiful glass and glitter, but no scene inside and the dome overlaps the base oddly, so it reads more as a glitter ball.

Y.note: Clear and cheerful daytime snow globe with a cabin, but flat drawing, a thin base and sparse snow.

Z.note: Cozy room with a cabin and trees under a pale dome, but the globe sits tilted at rest, the scene looks washed out and the bottom bar is cramped.
